findings.evidence: Proof body lines 63-65: `rw [integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]; simp_rw [norm_smul, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]; rw [integral_const_mul, integral_norm_sq_stdGaussian]` — only the final rewrite is about `stdGaussian`.
findings.fix: State the general dilation lemma `integral_norm_sq_map_const_smul {E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] (μ : Measure E) (c : ℝ) : ∫ x, ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∂(μ.map (c • ·)) = c ^ 2 * ∫ x, ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ` in a MeasureTheory extensions file, and obtain the stdGaussian version as `rw [integral_norm_sq_map_const_smul, integral_norm_sq_stdGaussian]`.
findings.issue: `integral_norm_sq_map_smul_stdGaussian` is stated only for `stdGaussian E`, but its proof uses nothing Gaussian and nothing about inner products or finite dimension: `integral_map` + `norm_smul`/`sq_abs` + `integral_const_mul` give `∫ ‖x‖² ∂(μ.map (c • ·)) = c² ∫ ‖x‖² ∂μ` for an arbitrary measure on a real normed Borel space (unconditionally, no integrability needed).

findings.evidence: Line 82: `rw [charFun_map_smul_stdGaussian, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]` — `Complex.norm_exp_ofReal` already yields the unsquared modulus; only the extra `exp_nat_mul`/`ring_nf` step specialises to the square.
findings.fix: Add `norm_charFun_map_smul_stdGaussian : ‖charFun ((stdGaussian E).map (σ • ·)) t‖ = Real.exp (-(σ ^ 2 * ‖t‖ ^ 2) / 2)` and derive `norm_sq_charFun_map_smul_stdGaussian` from it by squaring.
findings.issue: `norm_sq_charFun_map_smul_stdGaussian` exports only `‖F‖²`; the modulus itself, `‖charFun ((stdGaussian E).map (σ • ·)) t‖ = Real.exp (-(σ² ‖t‖²) / 2)`, is strictly stronger and has the same one-step proof (`charFun_map_smul_stdGaussian` + `Complex.norm_exp_ofReal`). The PR itself works with `1 - ‖F‖` on the below-bound side, so both forms are of interest.

findings.evidence: Lines 323-328: proof is `have h := mass_lt_energy_of_mem_photonRegion hk; rw [energy_def] at h; by_contra hγ; nlinarith`; `energy_def` is `s.energy = s.gamma * s.mass` (line 88), and `energyFraction_pos_of_mem_photonRegion (hm : 0 ≤ s.mass)` at line 297.
findings.fix: Weaken to `(hm : 0 ≤ s.mass)`; the two call sites in `Coherence.lean` and `energy_sq_lt_..._of_mem_photonRegion` already have `hm.le` available.
findings.issue: `gamma_pos_of_mem_photonRegion` assumes `0 < s.mass`, but the proof only needs `0 ≤ s.mass`: from `s.mass < s.gamma * s.mass` and `s.gamma ≤ 0`, `s.gamma * s.mass ≤ 0 ≤ s.mass` is already contradictory. The neighbouring lemmas in the same section (`energyFraction_pos_of_mem_photonRegion`, `energyFraction_lt_one_of_mem_photonRegion`, `mass_lt_one_sub_energyFraction_mul_energy_of_mem_photonRegion`) use `0 ≤ s.mass`.

summary: The charFun second-moment bound and the Minkowski/kinematics lemmas sit at the right level, but two Gaussian lemmas are stated below the level their own proofs establish: the dilated second moment is a fact about any measure, and the dilated form factor is exported only in squared form. One new kinematics hypothesis is also stronger than its proof needs.
